Oneliner

Open-source high school satellite to take pictures from space.
Description

High school student engineering group. Current goal is to send an open sourced CubeSat into Space to take pictures of the Earth from orbit. Our ultimate goal is to prove that anyone of any age or experience can send a satellite to space.
Notes

Thought to be cancelled for the lack of updates, but social media channels were changed.
